physics_findings: The laboratory r,v,q SDE closes a concrete mixed-inertia spring/contact apparatus. Transform z=(b/tau)(q-r) yields the submitted drift/noise; reference independently assembles r,v,q and integrates propagated white-noise covariance. Its transformed covariance and heat agree with the z-coordinate Lyapunov path.

The force on q is -z. Positive heat into B is the Stratonovich force contracted with dq-Aq dt. Its mean is tr(Czz)/b-2Tb/tau; the2 counts the two bath-point coordinates. The source is exact particle-relative spring work, -<z dot(v-Ar)>, from the same full covariance.

Ito balance of spring energy tau|z|²/(2b) gives Q_B=source+(tau/b)<z dot sym(A) z> at stationarity. Rotation gives identically zero connector deformation work, while strain can supply persistent energy. The total balance Q_A+Q_B=<z dot A q> has the correct sign. This is not a neglected covariance transport or endpoint-energy term.

At strain0 the calibration equality is exact for finite tau and all gamma. Static-flow nonzero thermal-contrast conductance is globally monotone for tau<=.6 because b/gamma²-tau>=.9/1.1²-.6>0. Nonzero thermal bias is required for that identification proof; extra rigid-rotation records are informative but not necessary to establish it.

Public outline specifies physical bath location, independent noises, separate flow actuator, thermostat sign and stationarity. It gives no missing correction formula or solver restriction. All strain controls affect exact mechanics and source work.
